name: How long does the air sealing process usually take for an average home?
description: Air sealing typically takes 1-3 days for an average home, depending on size and leakage. This includes assessment, sealing, and post-sealing tests.

mainEntity.name: How long does the air sealing process usually take for an average home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an air sealing project varies based on the home's size, age, and the extent of air leakage. A typical project for an average-sized home in areas like Berkeley or Albany might take anywhere from one to three days. This process clarity includes an initial assessment, sealing work in identified areas, and often a post-sealing test to ensure effectiveness, with minimal disruption to your daily routine.
